inbox.name: «Inbox» in the top bar
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.body: Notes and reminders are now one feed — open it from here or with G I.
inbox.mobile: Notes and reminders are now one feed. To write a thought down — the + above the navigation.

capture.name: Capture · N M / N R
capture.title: Write a thought down
capture.body: One line: with a time it’s a reminder, without — a note. N M / N R.
capture.mobile: Write a thought down in one line: with a time it’s a reminder, without — a note.

stage-menu.name: Stage selector
stage-menu.title: The stage, right on the board
stage-menu.body: Pick a sprint, the backlog or all tasks here or with ⇧E.

stage-strip.name: Stage strip
stage-strip.title: The stage’s goals and progress
stage-strip.body: Unfold the strip to see the description and the metrics. ⇧H folds or unfolds it.
stage-strip.wait: waits for a board with a stage

view-options.name: «Board view» button
view-options.title: Board view is here
view-options.body: Card size, fields and saved views. ⇧V.

view-chip.name: Saved view chip
view-chip.title: The board’s view
view-chip.body: Switch views quickly or take one back to how it was saved.
view-chip.wait: waits for the first saved view

project-settings.name: Project settings
project-settings.title: The «Project» window
project-settings.body: A project’s tags, stages and estimation are in one window — ⌘, or the project’s menu.

palette.name: ⌘K palette
palette.title: Everything from the keyboard
palette.body: Search, commands, actions on a task (Tab) — in the ⌘K palette.

undo.name: Undo a delete ⌘Z
undo.title: A delete can be undone
undo.body: The toast stays 7 seconds, and ⌘Z undoes the latest delete.

rail.name: Rail of spaces
rail.title: Spaces are on the left
rail.body: Each space has its own colour and icon. A new one is created with «+» at the foot of the rail.
